r0-context.title: Load context + verify rework handoff complete; lock the model empirically
r0-context.imperative: Read global-crew + global-everyone doctrine, CREW_CONTEXT/GLOSSARY if present, the g4-rework-addendum + original handoff + prior result + existing tyre_supplant.py/tests. Verify the rework handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Empirically lock the fuel-corrected model on real 2023 data (stint-ordinal FE + global linear fuel(lap_number) + per-compound tyre_life slope, scaled lstsq, median across races -> monotone SOFT>MEDIUM>HARD) and validate the synthetic recovery + naive confound. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: rework handoff verified complete; fuel-corrected model locked + monotone-up confirmed on real data; synthetic recovery + naive confound validated

r1-truth.title: Reshape build_truth_cells (fuel-corrected cross-stint) + adjust verdict criterion
r1-truth.imperative: Replace build_truth_cells' per-stint slope with the fuel-corrected cross-stint truth: per race, OLS lap_time ~ stint-ordinal fixed-effects + global linear fuel(lap_number) + per-compound tyre_life slope (scaled lstsq); per-(race,compound) gamma = deg_slope_raw, lap-count weight; within-race-centred deg_slope for scoring. Add deg_slope_raw to TRUTH_COLS. PURE lap-time + lap_number only (no physics/telemetry/#443). Per the Admiral-ratified verdict criterion, adjust classify_axis_verdict: GO = coverage + physics signal P>coinflip + physics-k monotone-up + LOO-honest + G3-separable (do NOT gate on beating the incumbent; report physics-vs-incumbent as CONTEXT); add the lap-time-family modality caveat; wire run_supplant to pass physics_monotone. Keep score_predictor/LOO/interval_overlap otherwise as-is. Evo-free.

postconditions.statement: module still evo-free; build_truth_cells exposes deg_slope_raw; API importable

r2-tests.imperative: Update the truth-channel tests to the reshaped model (lap_number column in the in-memory DB; new-truth recovery on an identified synthetic), update the verdict test(s) to the new GO criterion, and ADD a regression test: on synthetic with a known fuel ramp + known per-compound wear, the fuel-corrected truth recovers the wear ordering (SOFT>MEDIUM>HARD) while the naive per-stint slope is fuel-confounded (HARD/MEDIUM falsely negative) -> assert the naive slope is NOT what build_truth_cells uses.
